props.heading: Explore Our Services
props.content:
EVERYTHING YOUR CAT NEEDS

From a quick bath and brush to extended long-term boarding, Cats Luv Us offers a full spectrum of professional cat care services. Every service is delivered by trained cat care specialists in our clean, cat-exclusive facility.

Comfortable, climate-controlled boarding suites with daily enrichment, fresh meals, and 24/7 supervision. Choose from standard and luxury suites to match your cat’s personality and your budget.

A cozy, private suite with everything your cat needs for a comfortable stay including a soft bed, scratching post, and daily playtime with our care specialists.

Premium accommodations with extra space, window perches, elevated furniture, and enhanced daily attention. The ultimate boarding experience for your pampered feline.

Extended stay options for cats whose owners are away for weeks or months. Discounted monthly rates with all the comforts of our standard boarding experience.

Professional grooming services for all breeds and coat types, from quick maintenance sessions to comprehensive grooming packages that leave your cat looking and feeling their best.

A refreshing bath with cat-safe shampoo followed by a thorough brush-out, nail trim, and ear cleaning. Perfect for regular maintenance between full grooming sessions.

Our comprehensive grooming experience includes a bath, blow-dry, full brush-out, mat removal, nail trim, ear cleaning, and optional sanitary trim or lion cut.

A stimulating daytime environment with supervised play, climbing structures, window watching, and socialization opportunities for friendly cats. Drop off in the morning, pick up in the evening.

props.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
props.content:
No. Cats Luv Us is a cat-exclusive facility. We do not board, groom, or provide daycare for dogs. This allows us to maintain a calm, stress-free environment specifically designed for feline guests.

All cats must be current on FVRCP (feline distemper combo) and rabies vaccinations. We require proof of vaccination from your veterinarian before your cat’s first stay. If your cat is not current, please visit your vet before making a reservation.

Yes! Our trained staff can administer oral, topical, and injectable medications on your vet’s prescribed schedule. Please bring medications in their original containers with clear dosing instructions.

We provide everything your cat needs including food, bedding, litter, and toys. However, you’re welcome to bring your cat’s favorite blanket, toy, or a piece of clothing that smells like home — familiar scents can help cats feel more comfortable in a new environment.

We do our best to accommodate last-minute and emergency boarding requests, subject to availability. We recommend calling us directly at (949) 582-1732 for same-day or next-day boarding needs. Holiday periods book up quickly, so advance reservations are strongly encouraged.
